items.title: Card Product Analyst
items.text:
Department: Cards
Employment: Full-time
Location: Lagos, Nigeria

Role Summary

The Card Product Analyst supports the development and optimization of card products by analyzing product performance, customer behavior, and financial metrics. The role provides insights that inform product strategy, pricing, and portfolio growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product Performance Analysis

· Monitor card portfolio performance including spend, activation, utilization, and revenue.

· Track KPIs such as card issuance, transaction volumes, and interchange income.

Data Analysis & Insights

· Analyze customer usage patterns and spending behaviors.

· Provide insights to support product enhancements and marketing campaigns.

Reporting & Dashboard Management

· Develop and maintain product performance dashboards.

· Prepare regular reports for management and stakeholders.

Pricing & Profitability Analysis

· Support pricing strategy through revenue and cost analysis.

· Evaluate profitability across different card products and customer segments.

Product Development Support

· Assist in business case development for new card products.

· Support product launch initiatives with data analysis and performance tracking.

Requirements

· Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or related field.

· 2–4 years experience in product analytics, banking analytics, or payments analytics.

· Strong experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar tools.

items.title: Card Product Designer
items.text:
Department: Cards
Employment: Full-time
Location: Lagos, Nigeria

The Card Product Designer will be responsible for designing and enhancing customer-centric card products across debit and credit card offerings. This role focuses on developing product features, pricing structures, customer journeys, and value propositions that drive product adoption, usage, and profitability.

The ideal candidate will combine strong product thinking, market insight, and payments ecosystem knowledge to create innovative card solutions that meet customer needs while supporting business growth.

Requirements

Product Design & Innovation

- Design and develop innovative debit, credit, and premium card products.
- Define product features including rewards programs, benefits, pricing models, and target customer segments.
- Develop compelling value propositions that differentiate the product in the market.

Customer Experience Design

- Map and optimize end-to-end customer journeys including application, onboarding, activation, usage, and servicing.
- Work closely with UX/UI and digital teams to create seamless card experiences across mobile and web platforms.
- Identify opportunities to simplify and improve the customer experience.

Market & Competitive Analysis

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify emerging trends and product opportunities.
- Benchmark card products, pricing models, and benefits against local and international competitors.

Product Development

- Collaborate with technology, operations, compliance, and card scheme partners to develop and launch new card products.
- Support product roadmap planning and innovation initiatives within the cards business.

Product Performance Optimization

- Monitor and analyze product performance metrics, customer behavior, and usage trends.
- Recommend enhancements to improve customer engagement, product adoption, and profitability.

Key Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or a related field.

4–6 years of experience in card product management, digital banking, fintech, or payments.

Proven experience working with debit or credit card products.

Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem including card schemes and digital channels.

Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams such as technology, operations, and marketing.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Benefits

Competitive salary package

Health insurance coverage

Pension contribution

Annual leave and public holidays

Professional development and learning opportunities

Opportunity to work in a fast-growing fintech environment

items.title: Cards Data Analyst
items.text:
Department: Cards
Employment: Full-time
Location: Lagos, Nigeria

Data Analysis & Reporting

- Analyze card portfolio data to identify trends, patterns, and performance insights
- Prepare regular reports on key metrics such as transaction volumes, spend, and card usage
- Support ad-hoc data requests from business teams

Dashboard Development & Maintenance

- Develop and maintain dashboards using tools such as Power BI or similar platforms
- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting outputs
- Automate recurring reports where possible

Performance Monitoring

- Track key performance indicators including card issuance, activation, utilization, and revenue
- Highlight variances, anomalies, and areas requiring attention
- Support ongoing monitoring of business performance

Customer & Transaction Analysis

- Analyze customer behavior and transaction patterns
- Provide insights to support business decisions and operational improvements

Data Management Support

- Work with internal teams to ensure proper data capture and quality
- Assist in structuring and organizing datasets for analysis

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- 2–4 years’ experience in a Data Analyst role (preferably within banking, fintech, or payments)
- Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL
- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
- Ability to work with large datasets and perform data cleaning and validation

items.title: Information Security Governance Engineer
items.text:
Department: Information Technology Security
Employment: Full-time
Location: Hybrid (Lagos, Nigeria)

Governance & Policy

- Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
- Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks and standards (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001, PCIDSS, CBN Cybersecurity Framework).
- Define security governance structures, roles, and decision‑making processes.

Risk Management

- Support enterprise information security risk assessments and risk treatment plans.
- Maintain the security risk register and track remediation activities.
- Advise business units on risk acceptance, mitigation, transfer, or avoidance.

Compliance & Regulatory Assurance

- Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and contractual requirements (e.g. NDPR, CBN Cybersecurity Framework, PCI DSS, ISO 27001).
- Coordinate internal and external audits, assessments, and certifications.
- Track and remediate audit findings and compliance gaps.

Metrics, Reporting & Assurance

- Define and maintain security governance KPIs, KRIs, and dashboards.
- Prepare security posture reports for management, risk committees, and auditors.
- Support board‑level and executive reporting on information security matters.

Third‑Party & Vendor Security Governance

- Support third‑party security risk assessments and due diligence processes.
- Review supplier security controls and contractual security clauses.
- Monitor ongoing compliance of critical vendors.

Awareness & Continuous Improvement

- Support security awareness and policy training initiatives.
- Monitor regulatory changes and emerging governance trends.
- Drive continuous improvement of governance and control maturity.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Minimum of 5–9 years’ experience in information security governance, risk, and compliance (GRC).
- Hands-on experience implementing or managing security frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, CBN Cybersecurity Framework, NDPR, PCI DSS).
- Strong understanding of risk management methodologies and control frameworks.
- Experience working with audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory requirements.
- Familiarity with security tools and platforms supporting governance and compliance activities.
- Experience in financial services, fintech, or telecommunications is an added advantage.

items.title: Junior Business Analyst
items.text:
Department: Product Development
Employment: Full-time
Location: Lagos, Nigeria

Renmoney is a microfinance bank focused on expanding access to financial services across Nigeria. We provide loans, savings, and payment solutions designed to work for everyday Nigerians. We are building a data-driven organization where insights, not assumptions, back decisions.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Business Analyst Intern who is passionate about data and problem-solving. In this role, you will analyze product and financial data, generate insights, and support decision-making across teams, including Product, Risk, and Finance.

Key Responsibilities

- Dig into our product and financial data to find insights that drive real decisions (not slide decks)
- Build and maintain dashboards tracking MAU, Unit Economics, retention, and portfolio health
- Work directly with Product, Risk, and Finance teams to define and measure KPIs
- Support the modelling of customer cohorts, LTV, and NPL forecasting
- Translate messy data into clear, concise recommendations for the team
- Be part of the team building the analytics foundation as we scale from 40K to 3M active users

Requirements

- Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science) from a top university in Nigeria or South Africa
- Comfortable with SQL (or learning it fast), Excel, and at least one BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
- Can explain a complex analysis to a non-technical stakeholder in plain English
- Detail-obsessed but know when to ship a "good enough" answer versus waiting for perfect
- Think in systems, you naturally ask "why?" two or three levels deeper than most people
- Fast and Deep thinker with an experience in the oil and gas sector within the petroleum engineering, geophysics, reservoir modelling, and production economic path

Benefits

- Competitive salary aligned with the fintech market
- Exposure to senior leadership and cross-functional teams
- Clear growth path into senior roles within 12–18 months
- Opportunity to work on products impacting thousands of users
- Collaborative, high-performance team environment

items.title: Product Manager (Business Banking)
items.text:
Department: Product Development
Employment: Full-time
Level: Associate
Location: Lagos, Nigeria

As the Product Manager for Business Banking, you will spearhead the development and adoption of digital solutions to onboard and engage corporate clients on Renmoney’s web and mobile platforms. You’ll own the product vision for business banking, delivering features like business accounts, SME loans, bulk payments, and invoicing to meet the unique needs of Nigerian businesses. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you’ll drive revenue growth, ensure regulatory compliance, and create intuitive user journeys that redefine SME banking.

Job Description

- Product Strategy - define and own the product roadmap for business banking, aligning with Renmoney’s digital-first strategy and SME growth objectives. Propose innovative features like cash flow tools or API integrations to stay ahead of market trends.
- Corporate Onboarding - Design seamless digital onboarding journeys for SMEs and corporate clients on web and mobile, ensuring compliance with KYC/AML, CBN, NDIC, and NIBSS regulations. Optimize conversion rates across funnels.
- Feature Development - Lead end-to-end development of high-impact features (e.g., business account dashboards, user role management, bulk payments, invoicing, transaction insights, SME loans). Test and scale solutions with engineering and design teams.
- Stakeholder Collaboration - Partner with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Risk, Sales, and Distribution to align features with client needs. Work with Ops and Customer Service to ensure backend scalability and support.
- Analytics & Iteration - Leverage customer feedback, funnel data, and tools like Amplitude to drive decisions. Run A/B tests to improve adoption, engagement, and retention. Track KPIs like transaction volume and feature usage.
- Regulatory Alignment - Ensure all products comply with Nigerian financial regulations. Participate in risk reviews and policy formulation to maintain trust and security.
- Adoption & Growth - Collaborate with Sales to drive client acquisition and engagement. Optimize user journeys to boost business account activations and transaction volumes.

Requirements

- 4+ years in product management, with 2+ years in SME/business banking, fintech, or digital financial services
- Proven success launching digital onboarding or transaction products
- Strong knowledge of SME financial needs (e.g., lending, payments, KYC, invoicing)
- Ability to translate business problems into technical requirements
- Excellent communication skills to engage diverse stakeholders

Benefits

- Impact: Shape the future of business banking for Nigerian SMEs and corporates.
- Growth: Access professional development and career advancement in a fast-growing fintech.
- Culture: Work in a collaborative, innovative team with hybrid flexibility.
- Benefits: Enjoy competitive compensation, health insurance, and wellness programs.

items.title: Product Manager - Front-End Channels (Mobile/Web)
items.text:
Department: Product Development
Employment: Full-time
Level: Associate
Location: Hybrid (Lagos, Nigeria)

About Renmoney

Renmoney is a leading Nigerian fintech on a mission to make financial inclusion simple, accessible, and rewarding. As we scale our digital presence, we’re looking for a talented Product Manager to own and drive the user experience across our mobile app and web platforms, ensuring our customers enjoy frictionless access to loans, savings, bill payments, transfers, and account management features.

Role Summary

The Product Manager for Front-End Channels will lead the strategy, execution, and continuous optimization of Renmoney’s Mobile and Web customer-facing platforms. You will work with cross-functional squads — including engineering, design, QA, marketing, and business stakeholders — to create intuitive and delightful digital journeys that drive engagement, conversion, and revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities

- Product Strategy & Vision - Define and champion a compelling product vision for Mobile and Web channels, aligned with Renmoney’s business goals of increasing customer acquisition, retention, and transaction volume.
- UX Optimization - Lead UI/UX revamps to improve usability, accessibility, and inclusiveness, especially for non-tech-savvy users. Partner with design to ensure consistency, performance, and visual appeal.
- Execution & Delivery - Own the product backlog. Prioritize features, manage sprints, and coordinate across Engineering, QA, DevOps, and BA teams to deliver timely, high-quality updates.
- Customer-Centric Design - Use customer feedback, usability testing, and behavioral analytics to optimize onboarding, in-app navigation, and key feature adoption.
- Conversion & Engagement - Drive improvements in loan funnel conversion, savings engagement, and transaction completion. Proactively reduce drop-offs and increase session stickiness.
- Cross-functional Collaboration - Collaborate with Lending, Banking, Risk, Customer Service, and Marketing teams to ensure platform scalability, compliance, and readiness for new initiatives.
- Compliance & Regulation - Ensure all front-end features meet Nigerian fintech regulatory and data privacy standards. - Advocate for inclusive design to drive financial access.
- Release Management - Plan and coordinate beta rollouts, production deployments, and emergency hotfixes in collaboration with DevOps and QA.
- Product Analytics - Define and monitor KPIs — including activation, MAU/WAU, churn, drop-off points — using tools like Firebase, Mixpanel, and Google Analytics

Requirements

- 5+ years of Product Management experience in fintech or digital banking; 3+ years managing mobile/web platforms with proven outcomes in user growth and engagement.
- Technical Exposure - Understanding of REST APIs, mobile/web architecture, analytics integration, and Agile methodologies.
- Tools Proficiency - JIRA, Confluence, Figma, Miro, Productboard (or equivalent), Firebase/Mixpanel, Google Analytics. SQL is a plus.
- Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or related field. MBA or Product certifications (e.g., Pragmatic, AIPMM) is a plus.
- Soft Skills - Strong ownership mindset, analytical thinking, storytelling ability, cross-functional leadership, and stakeholder influence at C-level.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Mobile App Conversion Rates (Loan Applications, Savings, Bill Pay)

- Weekly & Monthly Active Users (WAU, MAU)

- Onboarding Funnel Completion Rate

- Customer Retention & Churn (Mobile & Web)

- App Store Ratings and Reviews

- Page Speed, Uptime, and Hotfix Delivery Time

Benefits

- Impact: Shape the face of digital banking in Nigeria by delivering intuitive and life-changing user experiences.

- Ownership: Lead end-to-end product journeys with autonomy and measurable results.

- Growth: Work in a data-driven, agile, and collaborative environment with opportunities to grow into senior leadership.

- Flexibility: Hybrid work options, performance-based rewards, and a culture that values innovation, empathy, and diversity.
